properties.NAME: KNOX (Ind.)
properties.CHANGE: As an Ind. Territory county, KNOX (Ind.) gained non-county area in present Mich., Ind., and Ohio; lost to RANDOLPH (Ill.) and ST. CLAIR (Ill.), and lost to creation of CLARK (Ind.). KNOX (Ind.) included territory in present Ind., Mich., Ill., and Ohio.
properties.CITATION: (Ind. Terr., Exec. Journal, 98-100; Pence and Armstrong, 212, 520)
